data.body:
[P2] Pair input completion export with successful delivery acknowledgment

The unchanged local runner still allows duplicate terminal exports across successful invocations. A FLAT parallel using `first_successful()` can leave wait B pending while the root waits on A. B now exports during a checkpoint-free PENDING invocation that skips the completed parallel. The runner clears `UpdatedOperationIds` when constructing that input but never advances `handler_seen_seq` after its valid response. Once A completes, a subsequent step checkpoint returns B again, and the fresh plugin exports another terminal span in both views. Pair this behavior with successful-response watermark acknowledgment, preserving newer updates, and add the three-invocation regression.
